description: This file defines shell functions for filesystem checking (fsck) using e2fsck for ext2, ext3, and ext4 filesystems. It includes logic to handle different exit statuses and logs messages accordingly. It also appends filesystem types to a known fsck list.

methods.name: fsck_e2fsck
methods.description: Performs filesystem check using e2fsck, handling different exit statuses and logging the outcomes.

methods.name: fsck_ext2
methods.description: Wrapper around fsck_e2fsck for ext2 filesystem.

methods.name: fsck_ext3
methods.description: Wrapper around fsck_e2fsck for ext3 filesystem.

methods.name: fsck_ext4
methods.description: Wrapper around fsck_e2fsck for ext4 filesystem.
